audit.subject: SymForge
audit.security_redaction: SF-SEC-01 to SF-SEC-08 are listed by generic title and priority only. Evidence, attack scenarios and fixes are held privately and will be published after the fixes ship.

priority_levels.P0: Immediate correctness, security or data-loss risk
priority_levels.P1: Major reliability, performance or product-mission issue

confidence_levels.measured: Observed or measured by a command or tool call run in this audit
confidence_levels.code-confirmed: The auditor read the cited lines
confidence_levels.delegate-reported: A subagent read the cited code; the auditor did not re-read every line
confidence_levels.plausible-unverified: Consistent with the code read, not exercised or fully traced

findings.title: A whole-task token reduction has not been demonstrated on the current version
findings.description: The repo's only 11.x cohort returned NO_WIN and observed no SymForge call in any session; its arms still differed by about 19% in total tokens, which indicates the size of run-to-run noise. The one positive result is two pairs on 8.14.1. This audit's 36-run paired pilot found a 2 to 12% price-weighted edge after removing the largest known confound, concentrated in two task types and reversed in three, with no reduction in round trips and no detectable difference in correctness.
evidence: evidence/cost-model-output.txt: Sonnet (12 runs per arm) round trips 55 vs 53, retrieved chars -8%, unweighted tokens -7.5%, price-weighted -19%, price-weighted with rule files removed -12%, SymForge cheaper on 3 of 6 tasks; Haiku (6 runs per arm) round trips 26 vs 31, unweighted +12%, price-weighted -8%, with rule files removed -2%, cheaper on 2 of 6 tasks
findings.impact: The product's central claim is unproven in either direction. Decisions about what to build next have no objective signal.
findings.recommended_action: Build the three-arm benchmark in AUDIT.md section D.3 and gate every efficiency claim on it.
findings.verification: A scheduled run publishing per-category medians, pairs won and losing categories.

findings.title: get_repo_map appends about 2,500 tokens of digests to every call and drops the code tree first when over budget
findings.description: A Repository knowledge block of 64-hex digests and unit ids is appended unconditionally. When the response exceeds max_tokens the bounded summary keeps that block and omits the code topology. The default compact map truncated before reaching src/.
evidence: src/protocol/tools.rs:2091-2096 (budget summary keeps knowledge_map, omits topology)
Observed: get_repo_map(detail=tree,path=src,depth=1) returned about 350 tokens of tree and about 9,300 chars of appendix
findings.impact: Orientation, the first call in most sessions, costs about 7x its useful payload. Three calls were needed to see src/.
findings.recommended_action: Remove the knowledge block from the default response (offer it behind a section parameter). Budget the code tree first. Rank src-like directories ahead of dot-directories.
findings.estimated_saving: About 2,500 tokens per get_repo_map call (measured on this repo).
findings.verification: Byte count of get_repo_map responses in a fixture test; tree present under any max_tokens >= 500.

findings.title: get_repo_map estimate=true ignores path and the appended block
findings.description: The tree estimate is file_count * 10 regardless of path; the compact estimate is the constant 500. The tool description also promises a ~500 token overview.
evidence: Observed: estimate returned ~16000 tokens for a src depth-1 tree that measured about 350 tokens plus appendix; compact measured about 3,500 tokens against an estimate of 500
findings.impact: Agents that check cost before calling are misled in both directions. Reports a number that was not observed.
findings.recommended_action: Compute the estimate from the same filtered view the call would render, including any appendix.
findings.verification: Estimate within 20% of the rendered length in tests for each detail mode with and without path.

findings.title: In-product savings figures are estimates against an assumed baseline, presented as session efficiency
findings.description: health reported Efficiency 2.5x (60% reduction) and search_symbols 13.6x for a session consisting mostly of this audit's benchmark agents. Against a real native arm those agents retrieved 32% less content over all 36 runs (8% on Sonnet, 52% on Haiku). The product's baseline is an assumed 50-line by 80-character read window per result, not an observed alternative. The two figures are different metrics; the product's is an assumption presented as session efficiency.
evidence: health output during the audit: Tokens served 172,285; Competent-manual equivalent 437,064; Efficiency 2.5x (60% reduction)
evidence/cost-model-output.txt: retrieved chars over all 36 runs 290,208 vs 198,023 (-32%)
findings.impact: Violates the project's reporting invariant (CLAUDE.md). Users and agents are told a saving that measurement does not support.
findings.recommended_action: Relabel as an estimate with its baseline stated on the same line, or replace with observed counters (calls, bytes served). Drop multipliers.
findings.verification: No savings figure appears without either the word estimate and its baseline, or a benchmark run id.

findings.title: The default tool surface costs about 17,300 tokens before any call
findings.description: tools/list for the full surface is 69,295 bytes for 40 tools. Input schemas are 83% of it. Parameter descriptions are 30,610 bytes; project/projects entries 6,670 bytes across 34 entries; nullable unions 5,988 bytes; $defs 7,926 bytes. The compact surface is 4,630 bytes.
evidence: evidence/tool-surface-measurement.txt (measured against the installed 11.11.0 binary over stdio)
findings.impact: Clients that load every schema up front pay all of it in every session whether or not a tool is called. Clients that defer schemas pay per tool on first use. Which clients load eagerly was not surveyed, and a link to the NO_WIN cohort is not shown. Token figure is bytes/4, an estimate.
findings.recommended_action: Ship a lean default profile of 8 to 10 core tools. State project/projects semantics once. Emit plain optional types instead of nullable unions. Remove numeric format and minimum noise. Shorten parameter text.
findings.estimated_saving: 8,000 to 11,000 tokens per session (estimate from the measured breakdown).
findings.verification: tools/list under 30,000 bytes with no drop in benchmark task success.

findings.title: Search envelopes outweigh small answers
findings.description: A one-hit search_text returned six header lines (match type, source authority, parse state, completeness, scope, evidence) plus a trailing admission note around a three-line payload.
evidence: Observed search_text responses in this audit, for example the query 'Owned workflows routed' with group_by=symbol
findings.impact: Roughly 100 to 150 tokens of envelope per call (estimate). Contributes to SymForge returning more content than Grep on small lookups.
findings.recommended_action: Collapse the envelope to one line when every field is at its default and expand only on a non-default condition.
findings.verification: Envelope bytes per response in fixture tests.

findings.title: No count mode and tests excluded by default make completeness sweeps dearer than Grep
findings.description: For a rename-impact count across src/ and tests/, the SymForge arm returned 6x the content of Grep count mode.
evidence: evidence/paired-benchmark-runs.json task T4: retrieved chars 1,281 (native) vs 8,139 (SymForge), Sonnet means
search_text schema: include_tests defaults to false
findings.impact: SymForge loses on the completeness questions that precede a rename or refactor.
findings.recommended_action: Add a count or per-file summary mode to search_text. When tests are excluded and suppressed matches exist, keep the current hint and offer the one-call retry.
findings.verification: T4 content at or below the native arm in the benchmark.

findings.title: Reading several nearby regions takes more calls than one Read
findings.description: On module-facts and debugging tasks the SymForge arm made about twice the tool calls. Agents fetched symbols one at a time and mixed search_text, get_symbol and get_file_content.
evidence: evidence/paired-benchmark-runs.json tasks T3 and T6: tool calls 3.5 vs 7.0 and 6.5 vs 10.5; round trips 3.0 vs 4.5 and 5.0 vs 8.0 (Sonnet means)
B-T6 runs called get_symbol 2 to 8 times singly although targets[] exists
findings.impact: Each round trip re-reads about 83,000 tokens of fixed context in this environment. At an assumed one-tenth cache-read price that is equivalent to about 6,600 newly added tokens per extra call, two to three times the roughly 2,800 tokens of content a Sonnet run retrieved on average.
findings.recommended_action: Let search results return enclosing symbol bodies on request. Promote targets[] in the get_symbol description. Consider a combined definition-plus-callers lookup.
findings.verification: Round trips per task for T3 and T6 type tasks in the benchmark.

findings.title: The Grep hook injects index health JSON into context and counts it as routed
findings.description: Non-identifier grep patterns are routed to /health as a no-op, but the response body is emitted as additional context and the event is recorded as a routed success.
evidence: Observed after each non-identifier Grep in this session: {"file_count":1600,"symbol_count":56404,"index_state":"Ready","uptime_secs":N}
findings.impact: A few dozen tokens of irrelevant context per search and inflated source-search adoption counts.
findings.recommended_action: Return an empty hook response for the fall-through case and record a distinct skipped outcome.
findings.verification: Hook unit test asserting empty output and a non-routed outcome for regex patterns.

findings.title: One unreadable file disables hook enrichment while the tools report Ready
findings.description: Any Unreadable manifest entry forces degraded coverage. The sidecar serves only when freshness is Current and otherwise returns 503, which the hook records as a sidecar error and fails open. The MCP tools and /health continue to report Ready.
evidence: health during the audit: unreadable=2, freshness=degraded[ObservationFailed,ReconciliationPending], hook events routed 663 of 4,211, failed open 3,548 (3,493 as sidecar errors), post-edit impact routed 0 of 1,965
findings.impact: The main mechanism that steers agents to SymForge is silent most of the time. That this chain explains the historical 55% is a strong hypothesis; the reason is not logged (SF-ADOPT-02).
findings.recommended_action: Serve hook answers with a staleness note when freshness is degraded. Let a persistently unreadable path settle after a bounded number of sweeps. Expose freshness in the sidecar /health response.
findings.verification: Routed share above 95% over a week on a machine with a locked file in the tree.

findings.title: The hook failure reason is not persisted
findings.description: emit_live_refusal_fail_open records the outcome without index_not_ready, root_conflict or http_failure. The reason reaches stderr only in verbose mode.
findings.impact: 18,354 failures cannot be attributed to a cause from the log.
findings.recommended_action: Write reason= on sidecar-error rows as is already done for no-sidecar rows.
findings.verification: Log rows for each refusal branch carry a reason field.

findings.title: Hook Adoption (current session) counts rows from other daemon lifetimes and, with no session, the whole log
findings.description: Session ids are session-N from a counter that starts at 1 in each daemon process. The log is machine-wide, append-only and read in full on each health call. With no resolvable session the filter is skipped.
evidence: Observed: 6,861 events under session-1, then 4,211 under session-2 about an hour later
Torn rows observed in the log (delegate-reported)
findings.impact: The label asserts a scope that was not observed. The file grows without bound and is re-read on every health call.
findings.recommended_action: Record a daemon start epoch and project in each row and filter on both. Render an empty tally when no session resolves. Rotate the log. Write each row with one write call.
findings.verification: Test with two daemon lifetimes sharing a session id.

findings.title: Agents with SymForge available do not reliably call it, and the server gives no guidance
findings.description: The 2026-10-05 cohort observed no native SymForge invocation in any session. initialize returns no instructions string. Usage guidance exists only in client files the user must install.
findings.impact: Availability without use is pure cost. The shipped default is the configuration that lost.
findings.recommended_action: Return a short instructions string at initialize: when to prefer SymForge, which three tools to start with, and when not to use it. Measure the unsteered arm in the benchmark.
findings.verification: Share of unsteered sessions with at least one SymForge call.

findings.title: get_file_context outline expanded the test module with include_tests=false
findings.description: An outline request for src/cli/hook.rs with max_tokens=1800 listed about 40 test functions and then reported the sections incomplete.
evidence: Observed once in this audit; schema documents include_tests default false
findings.impact: About 40% of the requested budget spent on test names; the production outline was cut short.
findings.recommended_action: Collapse cfg(test) modules to one line in outlines unless include_tests is true.
findings.verification: Outline fixture test.

findings.title: get_symbol returns bodies without inner line numbers; one run miscited a line by 38
findings.description: Only the symbol's overall range is given. One SymForge-arm run that relied on get_symbol estimated an inner line number and was wrong by 38 lines. A SymForge-arm run that used get_file_content, which is numbered, cited correctly. One observed instance, not a rate.
evidence: evidence/paired-benchmark-runs.json run B-T1-r1 cited tools.rs:2024 for a statement at src/protocol/tools.rs:2062
findings.impact: Wrong citations in reviews and follow-up edits; extra verification calls.
findings.recommended_action: Offer line-numbered output for get_symbol, on by default for bodies over a small threshold.
findings.verification: Citation accuracy check in the benchmark grader.

findings.title: status prints hard-coded roadmap labels as if they were state
findings.description: l4_ledger: in_memory, deferred: b_results and superseded: multi_step_planner are literals.
evidence: status output observed in this audit
findings.impact: Noise for agents; reads as live telemetry.
findings.recommended_action: Remove from the default status output or mark as static build facts.
findings.verification: status output review.

findings.title: Trust signals contradict each other
findings.description: The same health output reports Status: Ready, coverage=degraded and freshness=degraded. Search results report Completeness: full for indexed scope. Readiness and freshness are separate axes computed in different places.
evidence: health output observed in this audit
findings.impact: An agent cannot tell whether to trust an answer. The sidecar treats the same state as unservable (SF-ADOPT-01).
findings.recommended_action: Derive one headline trust state from both axes and use the same rule in MCP tools, sidecar and health.
findings.verification: A single function computes the headline state for all three surfaces.

findings.title: The hook treats .html and .css as non-source although both are indexed languages
findings.description: is_non_source_path lists .html and .css among non-source extensions, so hook enrichment is skipped for them.
evidence: Index language list includes Html and Css (get_repo_map)
findings.impact: Minor loss of hook enrichment on front-end files.
findings.recommended_action: Derive the non-source list from the set of indexed languages.
findings.verification: Unit test over the language table.

findings.title: No standing benchmark; existing harnesses do not run in CI and cover old versions
findings.description: Four prior measurements exist, with 2 pairs, 5 pairs with no SymForge calls, tool-level recipes, and a run whose oracles failed 0 of 20. Debugging and review were never measured before this audit. Edits and refactors have one failed recipe.
findings.impact: No objective way to accept or reject an efficiency change.
findings.recommended_action: Implement AUDIT.md section D.3.
findings.verification: Scheduled workflow producing a results artifact.

findings.title: Client-side rule injection confounds comparisons, and SymForge reads bypass path-scoped rules
findings.description: In this environment the first Read of a .rs file injects five rule files, a median of 4,165 tokens (characters/4), in 15 of 18 native-arm runs and no SymForge-arm run. Those tokens are re-read on every later turn. Removing them moves the Sonnet price-weighted difference from -19% to -12% and the Haiku difference from -8% to -2%.
evidence: Non-payload context (growth - retrieved chars/4 - output) median: 10,364 tokens for 15 native-arm runs that used Read, 920 for 3 that used Grep only, 1,949 for 18 SymForge-arm runs; rule files explain about half of the gap, the rest was not broken down
findings.impact: Unadjusted benchmarks overstate SymForge. Agents working only through SymForge never load the project's path-scoped rules, which matters for edits.
findings.recommended_action: Control for hooks and rules in every benchmark cell. Document the interaction for users who rely on path-scoped rules.
findings.verification: Benchmark cells run with rules on and off.

findings.title: A degraded index rescans and republishes continuously
findings.description: While coverage is degraded the reconcile loop retries up to five times per sweep with backoff, on every sweep.
evidence: Observed: index_generation 104 to 1,710 in about 65 minutes with a clean working tree; knowledge publication counter 103, 109, 116 on three calls about a minute apart
findings.impact: Background CPU and I/O on an idle repo; generation churn that resets per-generation caches. That each attempt publishes is plausible, not traced.
findings.recommended_action: Back off when the degraded digest is unchanged between sweeps.
findings.verification: Generation counter stable on an idle tree containing one locked file.

findings.title: reconcile repairs counts no-op outcomes
findings.description: Reindexed, HashSkip and Skipped all increment the repairs counter.
evidence: health showed reconcile repairs: 40 on an idle tree
findings.impact: The counter overstates repair activity.
findings.recommended_action: Count only Reindexed and applied removals.
findings.verification: Unit test on the counter.

findings.title: reindex_after_write may hide a failed re-read
findings.description: The helper warns and returns unit when the post-write re-read fails, so the edit reports applied while the index stays stale until the watcher catches up.
findings.impact: A success message for a state that was not observed.
findings.recommended_action: Return a Result and surface a stale-index note in the edit response.
findings.verification: Test injecting a failed re-read.

findings.title: write_snapshot may quarantine the old snapshot and then fail the write
findings.description: For a prior-format index.bin the first checkpoint after an upgrade may be lost.
findings.impact: One cold start after upgrade.
findings.recommended_action: Write the new snapshot after a successful quarantine in the same call.
findings.verification: Upgrade fixture test.

findings.title: A wall-clock assertion in the default suite fails under load and, with fail-fast, hides most of the suite
findings.description: large_rust_file_indexing_is_linear_and_unchanged compares elapsed times for 1x and 4x input.
evidence: src/parsing/mod.rs:2297: '4x the bytes took 5.273568s against 998.879ms: indexing is superlinear again'
First audit run of cargo nextest run --workspace: 2,129 of 4,790 tests run, 2,128 passed, 1 failed after retry, 2,661 not run
See COVERAGE.md for the second run
findings.impact: False reds and lost coverage on busy machines and CI runners.
findings.recommended_action: Move timing assertions to the scheduled performance job, or assert on operation counts instead of wall time.
findings.verification: Suite passes under induced CPU load.

findings.title: No automated dependency advisory gate
findings.description: No deny.toml at the repository root and no cargo-deny or cargo-audit step in the workflows. 387 locked packages.
evidence: Glob for deny.toml: only test fixtures
Grep of .github for cargo-deny, cargo audit, rustsec: no matches
findings.impact: Advisories are checked by hand (commit #849 records a manual cargo deny check advisories run) rather than detected automatically.
findings.recommended_action: Commit a deny.toml and run cargo-deny in CI. Note that workflow edits require the fingerprint update described in CLAUDE.md.
findings.verification: CI job fails on a seeded advisory.

findings.title: The embed lane re-implements the tool surface
findings.description: About 21,000 lines in src/index_lifecycle/embed_*.rs mirror server handlers, kept equal by parity tests.
findings.impact: Every behaviour change is made twice. Medium confidence: the two paths were not diffed line by line.
findings.recommended_action: Make server handlers thin adapters over the shared guidance layer and shrink the parity layer as it grows.
findings.verification: Lines in the parity layer; number of parity tests needed.

findings.title: Cyclic module dependencies and lifecycle modules with no production callers
findings.description: live_index, index_lifecycle, protocol, knowledge and embed import each other. Three index_lifecycle modules are documented as having no production callers.
findings.impact: The engine cannot be understood or tested in isolation; unfinished code ships.
findings.recommended_action: Define one-way layering. Remove or feature-gate modules without production callers.
findings.verification: Dependency-direction check in CI.

findings.title: Very large files and functions
findings.description: src/protocol/tools.rs is 34,120 lines and src/daemon.rs 19,818. 94 of 310 source files exceed 800 lines and hold 80% of source lines. Functions of 400 to 550 lines exist.
findings.impact: Review and symbol-level editing are hard exactly where change is most frequent.
findings.recommended_action: Split tools.rs by tool family and move its tests to sibling files. Split the longest functions into phases.
findings.verification: Count of files over 800 lines.

findings.title: Tests pin bytes and structure rather than behaviour
findings.description: A whole-src seal, workflow fingerprints and document phrase pins fail on any edit to the pinned text.
evidence: CLAUDE.md documents PR #612 failing on a four-line workflow edit
findings.impact: Every source or workflow change carries a mandatory second edit; failures do not indicate regressions.
findings.recommended_action: Replace the source seal with the specific call-edge check it protects.
findings.verification: CI failures attributable to pins only.

findings.title: Release and CI complexity
findings.description: release.yml is 2,641 lines with 12 jobs and 81 steps. Recent fixes addressed release failures in the pipeline itself.
findings.impact: A release can be blocked by the pipeline rather than the product.
findings.recommended_action: Move the largest gate job into a script or reusable workflow. Document a manual release path.
findings.verification: Release dry run from the documented manual path.

findings.title: Vendored rmcp patch is not applied for cargo install; unused feature; large binary
findings.description: The lifecycle patch is ignored by crates.io installs. The cbm-spike feature has no consumer. A release binary measured 66.5 MB.
evidence: target/release/symforge.exe size from an October build (delegate-reported)
findings.impact: Users of cargo install get a known bug.
findings.recommended_action: Upstream the patch or document the install limitation prominently. Remove the unused feature.
findings.verification: Feature list; install note.

findings.title: Two token estimators and a truncated knowledge bridge
findings.description: One estimator rounds up, the other truncates. The knowledge bridge reports 48,858 omitted links on this repo, which holds 8.66 MB of Markdown.
findings.impact: Small disagreements in reported numbers; knowledge search runs on a truncated graph here.
findings.recommended_action: Share one estimator. Exclude archived research and review documents from the knowledge scope by default.
findings.verification: Single estimator symbol; bridge coverage on this repo.

findings.title: Scope has outgrown the mission
findings.description: 41 tools, a knowledge index, curation, secret remediation, an admin interface and an embed lane surround the few tools that carry the measured value (find_references, get_symbol, search_symbols).
findings.impact: Each addition raises fixed surface cost and maintenance load without evidence of benefit to the mission.
findings.recommended_action: Use the benchmark to decide which tools belong in the default surface. Freeze new tools until then.
findings.verification: Default surface justified tool by tool with benchmark data.
